difficulty.reason: Creating a Spotify app client ID and secret takes only a few clicks via the Spotify Developer Dashboard.

timeEstimate.notes: App creation and client credentials generation are immediate, but extended quota or quota extensions may require review.

requirements.text: A Spotify user account to log in to the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Acceptance of Spotify Developer Terms of Service.

steps.title: Log in to Spotify Developer Dashboard
steps.description: Navigate to the Spotify Developer Dashboard and log in with your Spotify account.

steps.title: Create an App
steps.description: Click on 'Create app', fill in the app name, description, and redirect URIs.

steps.title: Retrieve Credentials
steps.description: Copy your Client ID and Client Secret for use in your application's OAuth flow.

blockers.problem: App is in Development Mode and users cannot log in.
blockers.solution: Add the specific user's email address to the Users and Access section of the Spotify Developer Dashboard while in development mode, or request quota extension.

agentCanDo: Perform requests using obtained OAuth tokens
Interact with user playlists, playback state, and library once authenticated
developerMustDo: Register the app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard
Handle user consent flows and manage client secrets

managedOption.managedSufficientWhen: Managed OAuth is sufficient when you want to abstract away user token exchange and credential storage for standard integrations. This tool was built for a Composio assignment, and Composio sells managed OAuth.
managedOption.customRequiredWhen: Custom developer credentials are required when you need direct, unshared control over the app branding, custom scopes, or proprietary rate limits.

claims.claim: Spotify OAuth app registration workflow and permission configuration.

openQuestions: What is the exact automated review process timeline if an app applies for extended quota limits?
